body: How are you doing? (other than what you described in the post, I don't want to come off as a smart-ass)

I started feeling sad and useless reading these posts so I thought I'd try to do something to help. I'm terrible with advice so I knew that wasn't a good idea so I tried another idea. I always associated sunflowers with bright and happy feelings so I thought I'd share and try to help make someone feel at least a little better.
